category_law: All results below are source-free synthetic evidence. Nothing here is survey-semantic equivalence, nothing qualifies a real source, and no real survey file was opened, stat-ed for content, hashed, decoded or materialised.

identity.lineage_check: startup SHA is exactly 1 commit over the executable freeze, so the implementation base is the freeze as commissioned

environment.note: no package, interpreter or extension was modified; only the application's call site changed, matching the HQ195 feasibility lane's burden finding

seam_one_closed.name: literal source-path access is application-owned, countable and enforceable
seam_one_closed.mechanism: pyreadstat's existing file-like-object bridge. The application performs exactly ONE physical open and lends it to the compiled reader through a position-zero view exposing fileno().

requirements_met.prevents_silent_raw_path_fallback: iter_batches raises RawSourcePathEscape when no broker is attached; verified zero regressions, so no caller relied on the removed fallback
requirements_met.keeps_accounts_separately_typed: path_opens, logical_views, hash_passes, header_prefix_reads, metadata_reads, selected_reads, full_reads, chunk_reads, reader_invocations, reader_read_calls, reader_bytes are each distinct counters
requirements_met.pins_and_asserts_the_pyreadstat_seam: version pinned to 1.3.6; usecols presence and the filename_path parameter name checked on the genuine entry points; a mismatch raises ReaderSeamViolation
requirements_met.sha_and_header_routed_through_the_same_g: the hash pass and the header-prefix read both run over the broker's single open, so the path-open account covers the whole scope rather than only the decoder

seam_one_closed.count_policy: The count follows the implementation. One open is what the implementation needs to serve the whole governed scope; it was not forced toward a desired warrant value.
seam_one_closed.truthfulness_note: logical_views is reported separately from path_opens precisely so that a rewind is never presented as a fresh open. Verified: account.logical_views == the number of views actually issued, and account.path_opens == the number of physical opens actually performed.

seam_two_closed.name: selected-variable physical read for SRC02/SRC06/SRC14
seam_two_closed.mechanism: pyreadstat usecols, bound to the selected variable set before any row data is read

requirements_met.selected_names_and_ordinals_bound_before: metadata is read first; the selection is checked against the real column inventory and the ordinals are bound and recorded before the selected read is issued
requirements_met.unexpected_or_missing_selected_columns_f: a selection naming an absent column raises DecoderError before any row read; a reader returning an unselected column raises SourceAccessViolation UNEXPECTED_SELECTED_COLUMN; an omitted bound column raises MISSING_SELECTED_COLUMN
requirements_met.no_unselected_row_data_columns_read_wher: NOT SUPPORTED BY THE LIBRARY — see honest_limitation below. Reported as not enforced rather than claimed.
requirements_met.selected_read_count_and_configuration_re: selected_reads is its own counter and selected_read_configuration records the mechanism, names, bound ordinals and the bound-before-read flag
requirements_met.full_read_count_remains_zero: the selected route pins full_reads=0 by default and a full read on that route is refused before it executes
requirements_met.no_change_to_missingness_typed_values_au: the existing classify_physical_value path, _physical_value normalisation, missingness states, reader configuration and physical metadata digest inputs are unchanged; equivalence is demonstrated at the declared synthetic grain only

api_addition.what: an optional selected_variables parameter on _decode/decode_sav/decode_dta, plus source_access_budget
api_addition.why_minimal: the existing public API could not express a selected read at all, so this is the smallest explicit addition that can
api_addition.backward_compatible: both parameters default to None, so every existing call site is unchanged in behaviour

dta_chunk_constraint.problem: the feasibility lane found that reusing one broker object across row-offset parses fails because ReadStat expects the object at position zero
dta_chunk_constraint.solution: a fresh logical VIEW per logical parse, each a rewind of the SAME physical open

proof.naive_reuse_still_fails: court C5b asserts that reusing ONE view object across two row_offset parses raises, so the constraint is real and the reset is load-bearing rather than decorative
proof.reset_design_succeeds: the same single open yields correct chunks: rows [1,2] / [3,4] / [5,6] for DTA and the same for SAV, with physical_opens == 1
proof.no_extra_physical_opens_for_convenience: 5 logical views over 1 physical open on a 10-row carrier; the open count did not rise to make chunking convenient
proof.no_silent_path_fallback: read_file_in_chunks is not used at all; it works over a file-like for SAV but fails for DTA

dta_chunk_constraint.mechanism_used: an explicit row_offset/row_limit loop issuing one view per chunk — the 'another exact mechanism' the commission permits

honest_limitation.statement: pyreadstat 1.3.6 does NOT enforce that unselected columns go unread.
honest_limitation.measurement: 12-column / 200-row SAV, 20,159 bytes on disk. Full read and usecols=["c00"] each issued 278 read calls and 20,659 bytes — byte-identical.
honest_limitation.consequence: The selected route delivers a genuine LOGICAL selected-read account (selected_reads=1, full_reads=0, usecols bound and recorded). It does NOT deliver physical suppression of unselected column reads, and this candidate does not claim it.
honest_limitation.how_it_is_reported: the receipt field selected_route_physical_column_suppression carries NOT_ENFORCED_BY_READER with the measurement, and court C9c asserts that disclosure is present so it cannot be quietly dropped.
honest_limitation.why_it_matters_to_R9: O1-C07 requires the accounts to stay separate and explicitly warns against conflating layers. This is a case where a real physical property is unattainable at the current layer, and saying so is the correct output rather than substituting a proxy.

mandatory_nine.C6_budget_negative_cases_refuse_before_e: PASS — asserts the refusal happens BEFORE the read by showing reader_bytes unchanged and header_prefix_reads still 0
mandatory_nine.C7_raw_path_escape_negative: PASS — captures the first positional argument of every reader invocation and asserts none is str/bytes/PathLike
mandatory_nine.C8_selected_column_wrong_or_missing: PASS — including a leaky reader that injects an extra column
mandatory_nine.C9_accounting_separation: PASS — every account key must also have a stated measurement basis

run_twice.the_two_failures: test_parquet_roundtrip_atomicity_corruption_and_direct_duckdb and test_direct_session_skips_full_reopen_and_supports_multiple_queries — both are ModuleNotFoundError for duckdb and both were verified failing at the PRISTINE freeze, so they are pre-existing and not caused by this candidate

declared_grain_comparison.prior_55_carrier_court: NOT LOCATED. No runner, corpus or expected-result artifact exists at the commissioned freeze, in the R7 qualification environment, or in reachable history; the figure appears only as prose in the HQ195 feasibility return. This corpus is constructed here at a declared grain, is NOT a re-run of the prior court, and inherits no PASS from it. Matching the count of 55 makes the denominator comparable, not the corpus identical.
declared_grain_comparison.value_normalisation: both sides pass through the decoder's canonical _physical_value. Raw pyreadstat yields NaN where the decoder contract yields None; an asymmetric comparison produced 8 spurious 'missingness' differences that were a harness artefact, confirmed by normalising both sides.

full_regression.method: the candidate was set aside and the pristine freeze restored to capture a real baseline, because a single run without a baseline could not distinguish a regression from pre-existing sparse-checkout failures
full_regression.pre_existing_failures_explained: the 335 failures and 58 errors are sparse-checkout artefacts: those tests import fixtures under paths outside the commissioned sparse manifest (WORKER_RETURNS/EE-P2X/..., and two test files absent from the tree entirely). The identical 5 collection errors were reproduced at the pristine freeze, proving they are not caused by this candidate.
regressions_caught_and_fixed_during_deve: selected-route variable inventory stayed full-length while the frame held one column, so emit() zipped selected values onto the WRONG variable names — a real correctness bug that would have misattributed a selected cell to an unselected variable
_bump used dataclasses.replace, which SETS fields rather than adding, so zeroed delta entries wiped accumulated counters and the account reported last-operation values instead of totals
kwarg filtering against the reader signature silently dropped metadataonly and usecols when the reader was a (*args, **kwargs) test double, downgrading a metadata read into a full read
the source-access receipt was snapshotted during decode, so later chunk reads were invisible in the very account meant to record them
the default budget capped full_reads globally, wrongly forbidding the ordinary compatibility decode; the zero-full-read law belongs to the selected route only
the governed hash seam was unobservable, so the identity-gate-before-reader-access property could no longer be audited

rawlsing_next/tests/test_pre553_sr06_dec.test_expected_source_identity_is_hashed_: instruments decoder._governed_source_sha instead of decoder._sha, because the hash now runs over the broker's open rather than opening the path. Intent preserved exactly: hashed once, reader never called, DecoderError raised.
rawlsing_next/tests/test_pre553_sr06_dec.test_normal_decode_uses_chunk_path_and_c: previously asserted pyreadstat.read_file_in_chunks was called with chunksize=2. That helper was deliberately replaced because it fails for DTA. The test now asserts the GOVERNED property instead: chunk reads occurred, exactly one physical open, correct cells with correct ordinals, and compatibility still performing metadata-then-full-read with no selection.
rawlsing_next/tests/test_pre553_sr06_dec.disclosure: both edits follow a deliberate mechanism change the commission required. Neither weakens an assertion: each was rewritten to test the governed property rather than the removed helper, and the identity-gate test still fails if a reader is reached before the hash.

not_done_and_declared: The out-of-terrain production pyreadstat sites in runtime/ee_p2x/05_WVS7_PROJECTION_MATERIALIZER.py remain raw-path reads. They are outside this commission's write terrain and were neither brokered nor modified. Whether they are inside the C4 governed closure was not determined; that is an authority question.
The prior named 55-carrier court was not re-run because it could not be located. No pass is inherited from it.
Physical suppression of unselected column reads is not achieved and is not claimed.
No adoption, no self-adoption, no warrant, no locator work, no live C4.
